# An implausible vanId hides a create behind the 302

**Claim.** A vanId outside the range the database has ever assigned is ignored — but the request is not refused: the rest of the payload is stored as a new person record, and the answer is still the 302 Matched stub, pointing at the person just created. Only the unfamiliar vanId in the response betrays that something was written.

Applies to: `~1people~1create/post`

## Observed exchange

_An id no record has ever had, far beyond the assigned range._

```http
POST /people/create

{
  "vanId": 2147483646,
  "firstName": "Implausia",
  "lastName": "Storedanyway-{scope}"
}

→ 302
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Matched"
}
```

_The 'match' is a person that did not exist a moment ago._
